verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge documents a role-based ability for an owner to delete individual pages, and pages are partitioned into per-customer or per-team scopes. That gives single-item deletion of stored agent knowledge. Nothing in the evidence shows bulk deletion by scope or entity, or a full-erasure operation for privacy requests. Missing for 10: per-entity/per-scope bulk deletion, full erasure of all of a user's data, an API or programmatic delete for privacy workflows, and any privacy/compliance-oriented documentation or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can delete a user's memories on demand — single memory, per-entity, or full erasure — to satisfy privacy requirements

citations.quote: an owner can also delete pages and move them between scopes
Each customer's or team's pages live in their own scope
